text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото asks me to review her diet
results
after dealing with a slow
metabolism.

Have a... look at this... My weight is
nearly what it
was before.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Why do you look so exhausted?!

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm just... a little hungry... but my
body feels
so empty and light.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I guess this is the result of diligent
fasting...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: You're depriving yourself of essential nutrients!

text_block_list.text:
You might be onto something... Instead
of feeling
light, I... think I'm feeling
weak.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Oh no, did I make another mistake?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Trainer, is there any hope for me?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото rebalances her diet with
proper
nutrition and a fitness regime to
get back in good
shape.
